purpose: Specify a domain in which a statement applies.
keywords: N + 上; read じょう
For safety reasons, this door is kept closed.
I often travel abroad for work.
formation: N + 上; read じょう
restrictions: Common with 制度, 法律, 安全, and 仕事; denotes a domain or viewpoint.
mistake: Do not read this suffix as うえ in compounds such as 法律上.
